semantic_scope: The Commons metadata query/request failed; any top-level error member triggers the branch regardless of null, false or empty-object value. No cause or additional operation is implied.

ko-KP.backtranslation: The request for Commons metadata failed.
ko-KP.rationale: The independently retrieved computing textbook explicitly uses 메타자료 for metadata and 자료요청 for a logical data request. 요청 therefore has regional source support absent from the original proposal’s 조회. 실패하였습니다 is a formal completed-failure predicate. The whole construction identifies failure of the metadata request and does not say request transmission, the network, HTTP, metadata absence or image downloading failed.
ko-KP.change_assessment: Supports replacing 조회 with 요청 on evidence grounds; does not prove that 조회 was ungrammatical or semantically wrong.
review_limit: The complete UI sentence is model-composed, not quoted or independently attested in the source.

The book identifies 교육성 교육정보쎈터 as its issuing institution, but the retrieved copy is on a third-party mirror; authenticity, edition and present-day official terminology have not been independently established.
Medium confidence is bounded language/semantic review, not native-speaker certification or release acceptance. No Android runtime/rendering check was performed.

mn-Cyrl-MN.value: Commons-ын мета өгөгдлийн хүсэлт амжилтгүй боллоо.
mn-Cyrl-MN.backtranslation: The request for Commons metadata was unsuccessful.
mn-Cyrl-MN.rationale: The official foreign-word rules §49.5–6 require back-vowel suffixes for a foreign word containing a back vowel. Applying that rule to the ordinary pronunciation of Commons supports Commons-ын rather than Commons-ийн. The remainder identifies a metadata request and states its unsuccessful result without inventing a cause.
mn-Cyrl-MN.change_assessment: Confirms the -ийн to -ын correction under the ordinary spoken reading of Commons. The proper name remains recognizable and in Latin letters.
review_limit: Suffix choice is an application of the official rule to the ordinary pronunciation of Commons, not a source-attested inflected spelling of this particular product name.
The NUM source writes мета-өгөгдөл with a hyphen; it validates the metadata concept, not an exclusive rule against the proposed transparent two-word spelling мета өгөгдөл.
The complete sentence is model-reviewed, not externally attested, native-speaker certified or release accepted. No Android runtime/rendering check was performed.
